question_text: A RAG pipeline returns irrelevant chunks and you suspect the embedding model is the culprit. Which diagnostic most directly tests whether the embeddings capture semantic similarity correctly?

options.text: Embed known similar and dissimilar sentence pairs and verify cosine similarity is high for similar pairs and low for dissimilar ones
Raise the temperature of the generation model
Add more denied topics to the guardrail

explanation: A direct embedding-quality diagnostic runs known similar/dissimilar text pairs through the embedding model and checks that cosine similarity is high for semantically similar pairs and low for unrelated ones; failures indicate a poor or misconfigured embedding model. maxTokens and temperature affect generation, not retrieval embeddings; guardrail topics are a safety control.

question_text: Users intermittently experience multi-second delays on the first request after a period of inactivity, while warm requests are fast. X-Ray traces show the delay is in Lambda initialisation, not in Bedrock. Which remedy most directly resolves the intermittent slow-start latency?

options.text: Enable Lambda provisioned concurrency to keep execution environments warm
Switch the vector index from HNSW to IVF

explanation: Intermittent slow first-requests after idle periods, with the delay in Lambda init per X-Ray, are classic cold starts; provisioned concurrency keeps environments initialised so the critical path avoids cold-start penalty. Temperature affects output randomness; the ANN index choice affects retrieval, not Lambda init; adding a guardrail does not address initialisation latency.
source_topic: Cold-start latency resolved with provisioned concurrency
